name: Sanctuary
line: Arrival at a remote retreat: a full-screen Himalayan dawn that slowly breathes in (scale 1.08 to 1 over about six seconds) under a light Newsreader headline and a hairline search, then quiet mist-coloured sections where a second landscape, a golden misty lake, is revealed behind the one idea as a fixed background; the two explorers are presented as large landscape panels with their three figures.
notes: photo-mist-mountains-2 is deliberately not used (its photographer asks to be contacted before commercial use). The masthead is set in dark type on the pale dawn sky and the headline in white over the dark ridges with a quiet shadow gradient, so both pass AA. The two explorer panels use landscape photographs (laurels in fog, a shoreline at dusk) as their pictures rather than the network drawings. The fixed lake uses a clip-path window with a position:fixed image (works in current Chrome, Safari and Firefox; where unsupported the photo simply scrolls). Newsreader has no Cyrillic; Tenor Sans does.
